title: David Sacks: OpenAI and Anthropic Don't Need Regulations to Pace Frontier Models
summary: David Sacks argues that OpenAI and Anthropic do not require government regulation to control the pace of frontier model development, implying market forces or internal safety practices suffice. The Hacker News discussion (313 points, 234 comments) debates AI regulation, competitive dynamics, and whether voluntary pacing is credible given commercial incentives.
